usedFor: Roma keeps lists, tasks and notes, and HubSpot keeps the sales pipeline. A “New Item” added to a Roma list can open a record with “Create Deal”, handy when prospects first get written down as list items.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Roma, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Roma pushes “New Item” as soon as someone adds one, so a prospect noted in a list reaches the HubSpot pipeline without being retyped.

watchOut: “Updated Item” and “Deleted Item” can run the same “Create Deal”, so a template built on those would create deals from edits and deletions. Pick “New Item” only.
